title: Ethiopian Skewers with Sesame
description: A flavorful and aromatic Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring tender meat and crunchy sesame seeds. Serve with your favorite sides for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: Beef or lamb work well for this recipe

ingredients.name: sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: Toasted sesame seeds add a nice crunch and nutty flavor

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Chop onion thinly for best results

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the skewers

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated ginger adds a warm, spicy flavor

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, Ethiopian spice blend, salt, and garlic.
Add the onion and ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Thread meat and onion mixture onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
During the last 2 minutes of cooking, sprinkle sesame seeds over the skewers.
Serve skewers hot and garnish with additional sesame seeds, if desired.
